description: This script provides functions to perform firmware upgrades on Netgear Orbi devices with ipq40xx architecture. It includes procedures to locate partitions, flash kernel and root filesystem, handle loop devices, and reconfigure the device.

methods.name: platform_do_upgrade_netgear_orbi_upgrade
methods.description: Main upgrade sequence that checks prerequisites, identifies partitions, initiates flashing, and reboots

methods.name: netgear_orbi_do_flash
methods.description: Handles the actual flashing process, including extracting files from the tar archive, writing kernel and root filesystem, and setting up overlay filesystem
